integrity: Proof is mathematical and characteristic-independent; finite exact-arithmetic checkers are corroboration, not infinite certification.
scientific_limitations: The normalization-fiber classification and n=2 nodes are prior results; extension point counts and zeta follow from earlier fiber data. No result for arbitrary rational singular curves; specialist historical-priority risk and no external audit.
scientific_scope: For prime powers q>=2 and integers n>=3, complete transverse formal local types and k-group structure of Pic0 of the Fukasawa-Homma-Kim B_n curves; point counts and zeta as known-fiber corollaries.
title: Transverse Frobenius-orbit singularities and the Picard torus of higher Ballico–Hefez curves
